dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: According to legend, when the Bloodstained Knight left the Knights of Favonius 500 years ago to embark on the path of demon hunting, some knights chose to follow him, leaving Mondstadt together with the champion they revered.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: To this day, their names are still recorded in the archives of the Knights of Favonius, though what happened after their departure remains unknown.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Is it because of the unique influence of the Ley Lines here, or was their longing and willpower so intense that these voices still linger...?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Unless I'm mistaken, this must be their final destination.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Though they had left the Knights, they fought bloody battles to uphold the chivalry in their hearts, until all that was left was one lone wolf...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: No one can fault you for your deeds. Every action you took was truly befitting your knightly titles.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: But it seems that the Bloodstained Knight could not return from the end of his path. It's an ending full of sorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: No matter what, the Knights of Favonius won't forget you. Your deeds ought to be celebrated by the world, and your spirits should be returned to your homeland.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Heroic wolf, lead me to their bones.
